direct_reply_pairs.rationale: Darwin explicitly thanks Hooker’s last note, answers his welcome for philosophical questions and values the specific variation cases as a subdivision of polymorphism.

evidence.quote: you would not fear bothering me with questions
Fucus varying much & yet in same way under most different conditions
The cases discussed in your last note are valuable to me
I shall just allude to these cases, as a sort of sub-division of polymorphism

direct_reply_pairs.incoming_scope: 2074 P2–10 botanical willingness, cases and qualifications; separate undated Darwin note excluded.
direct_reply_pairs.response_scope: 2075 P1–2 explicit acknowledgement and scientific interpretation. P3 initiates a new alpine-variation argument/query; experimental tables, further requests and Emma letter excluded from this strict reply section.
direct_reply_pairs.response_date_policy: April 12, supplied 1857; Hooker Saturday assigned April 11. No exact arrival statement for Hooker letter.

correspondent_replies.rationale: Hooker answers the precise Fucus/Juncus/Polygala, Oxalis and NZ variation questions and explicitly states inability to answer the Sonchus abundance question.

evidence.quote: Harvey gives cases of Fucus varying remarkably
Harveys observation on Fucus varying much
whether the introduced Sonchus in N. Zealand, was less, equally, or more common than the aboriginal stock
I am sorry that I cannot at all answer the Sonchus question

correspondent_replies.response_scope: 2074 P2–11 answers 2073 P2–7. Sonchus prediction is not an observed abundance result; family news and undated Darwin note separate.
correspondent_replies.response_date_policy: April 8 Darwin inquiry precedes Hooker Saturday assigned April 11; Hooker mentions arrival day without giving exact date.

cross_correspondent_knowledge.rationale: Darwin forwards Gray’s letter, identifies the distinctive tree-sex question and describes previous Watson consultation on its last sheet. Apparatus identifies the February 16 source.

evidence.quote: I have thought you would like to see enclosed which please return
I asked A. Gray whether he cd. tell me about Trees in U. States
why you were led to conclude a priori, that trees would have a stronger tendency to be mono-diœcious than herbs
I find I shall have to send back to Gray the latter half—of his letter

cross_correspondent_knowledge.knowledge_scope: Gray February 16 source available to Darwin by March 15. Only part forwarded to Hooker; latter half returned to Gray. No claim this is earliest possible witness or proof full forwarding.

reference_observations.description: Six original MathML fractions: 72/94, 62/94, 1/10, 1/7, 18/94, 64/87. Plain duplicate fallback follows 1/10 and 64/87. Preserve original .140 and above-1/7 phrasing rather than silently correcting arithmetic.
Not dried/Dryed headings and two numeric columns appear as successive paragraphs, not a semantic table. Preserve row-column associations and germination qualifications.
Protean genera list underlining degrees encode Gray relative confidence/badness; flattening destroys information. Separate Darwin annotations undated.
Actual experiment is millet to fish to stork to excretion/germination, not simply passage through fish as abbreviated editorial summary suggests.
Remembered Montpellier locality differs from later printed Toulouse quotation. Preserve attributed uncertainty and do not silently replace original.
P11 corrects initial reading of Hooker Huxley/Prestwich ranking; planned Sharpey letter becomes written by P12–13, dispatch not proved.
March 15 knowledge witness accepted. Watson March 10/13 correspondence and later direct Gray response need independent review before determining earliest cumulative activation.

corrections.description: Reject both Luna links joining Darwin outgoing letters; neither supplies an incoming prompt and their proposed topical rationales contradict source openings.
Worker missed explicit acknowledgement of 2074. Accept strict P1–2 response, not whole multi-topic letter.
Supplemental reverse lead supported, but its 2073 P9 book-progress quote was irrelevant; substitute precise botanical questions and corresponding replies.

summary: Thirteen targets and additional Gray source independently read; three accepted contexts reused with hashes. One direct reply, one reverse reply and one cross-correspondent knowledge witness. Two same-author proposals rejected; preserve open dates, missing prompts, undated separate hands, table/fraction layout and self-corrections.
